messages:
marta: Noticed p50/p95 shifts on the latency dashboard when requests get re-routed mid-flight. overall p95 jumps but primary route looks fine. anyone seen this before?
devin: yep. we currently attribute to final node for legacy reasons, which moves tail to whoever executed the request. that hides caller-side/per-experiment views.
lee: short data paste:
---
2026-03-23T09:10:01Z init=primary final=primary latency_ms=95
2026-03-23T09:10:02Z init=primary final=shard-B latency_ms=340
2026-03-23T09:10:03Z init=primary final=shard-B latency_ms=310
2026-03-23T09:10:05Z init=primary final=primary latency_ms=100
---
rachel: product folks want initial attribution (so experiment owners see their callers), infra wants final attribution for operational impact. both are valid.
infra-bot: note: telemetry pipeline currently sets "route_attribution"=final when final != initial (legacy).
marta: proposal: surface three modes in console and API: blended (existing), initial, final. show sample_count next to each percentile and a small toggle for SLO attribution.
devin: API change required: add `attribution_mode` param to timeseries endpoints; default = "final" for backward compat, but console can override. will draft deprecation plan.
lee: telemetry ops: to avoid heavy queries, compute ingestion rollups for p50/p95/p99 by both initial and final keys. cheaper at query-time. I'll estimate storage/cpu delta.
rachel: UX: default rollout chart to initial attribution with a dimmed final line. add tooltip: "p95 rose because 37% of tail requests ended on shard-B". also add low-sample warning when count < 50.
marta: action items: devin -> RFC + API spec; lee -> rollup cost estimate + small backfill; rachel -> mockups and tooltip copy; infra-bot -> open telemetry cost ticket. merging to sprint if no objections. :white_check_mark:
